title: Pin the PlantUML renderer and unify the diagram render helper
acceptance_criteria: PLANTUML_IMAGE is pinned in infra/versions.env to an exact tag or digest, matching the pinning rule that already covers PostgreSQL, YugabyteDB, Redis and the book toolchain
One shared render helper lives in infra/ and all three study render scripts delegate to it; no renderer logic is duplicated

Each study re-renders all of its sources; the result is either byte-identical to the committed SVGs or every differing file is individually reviewed and the difference recorded, including any digest migration
The resolved image digest is recorded next to the rendered output so a figure's renderer is traceable
No host Java or PlantUML installation is required
expected_artifacts: infra/versions.env entry for the pinned PlantUML image
validation: Re-render all three study diagram sets from a clean tree and inspect the diff
HIGH review confirms no committed SVG changed without an explicit recorded review
